breaking.change: The default pack sets a main menu's entries at text-4xl and a pause menu's at text-3xl (compact 2xl), half again the former size, so they read at arm's length on a 720p frame.
breaking.fix: A menu that must stay at the former size passes its own class to MenuEntry.

breaking.change: Screen.veil is now only what every veil shares and is empty by default, since a variant draws over its base: its fill lay under the side and foot gradients as a flat band. The even shade over the whole picture is Screen.veil.full.
breaking.fix: A pack that set Screen.veil's shade sets it on Screen.veil.full instead.

added.summary: What a full-screen built-in stands on: the key art, or with none the pack's designed ground (Screen.backdrop, Screen.glow, Screen.vignette), then the veil its words need (side, foot or full); over the running game it draws the veil alone.
A footer of input hints (A Select · B Back): each action's glyph on the device used last and its words, in the pack's Hint.bar and Hint.item; hidden on touch.

added.summary: Pack slots for a screen's fallback ground and its light and vignette, the side and foot veils, a headline number, the hint footer, what a menu list stands in, and a card's frame by rarity (Card.rarity.uncommon … mythic).
